_meta.what: streaming tissue probe: lock fine structure, cancel rigid relative motion, climb resolution to the coherence (max-Q) limit; emit positional+temporal coherence control signals.
_meta.data_ingestion: existing RF/IQ ultrasound (PICMUS plane-wave; CUBDL subsets) -> per-band scattering composition; model used here is grounded synthetic (T2)

motion_cancellation.meaning: patient may relax / move; rigid relative motion cancels as common-mode, the structure read holds

honest_fences.coherence_floor_caps_resolution: noise cannot fall below 0.008 (max-Q irreducible decorrelation)
honest_fences.out_of_plane_decorrelation: independent, NOT cancelled -- sets the floor
honest_fences.tier: T1 common-mode cancellation exact; T2 tissue model; T3 real RF data + clinical validation
